name: Cram School Mock Test (Aug 1, 2026) · Vocabulary
subtitle: Words & options from Module 1 and Module 2

words.defn_en: praised by

sentences.en: The chef was ______ every guest at the dinner.
sentences.zh: 主廚「受到」晚宴上每位客人的「稱讚」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: not sure about

sentences.en: I am still ______ which club to join.
sentences.zh: 我還「不確定」要參加哪個社團。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: not worried or annoyed by

sentences.en: The cat seemed ______ the loud music.
sentences.zh: 那隻貓似乎「不受」吵鬧音樂「影響」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: given ideas or a feeling to create something by

sentences.en: Her song was ______ her grandmother's stories.
sentences.zh: 她的歌「受到」祖母故事的「啟發」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: not causing disagreement

sentences.en: Adding more trees to the park was an ______ decision.
sentences.zh: 在公園增加更多樹木是一個「沒有爭議的」決定。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: independent and different from others
words.defn_zh: 個人主義的；與眾不同的

sentences.en: The designer is known for her bold, ______ style.
sentences.zh: 這位設計師以大膽、「與眾不同」的風格聞名。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: based on ideas rather than practice

sentences.en: The plan works in a ______ way, but no one has tested it yet.
sentences.zh: 這個計畫在「理論上」可行，但還沒有人試過。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: all of the same kind; not varied

sentences.en: The class is not ______; students come from many countries.
sentences.zh: 這個班級並非「單一同質」；學生來自許多國家。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: the reason why something happens

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the ______ of the fire.
sentences.zh: 科學家正在研究火災的「原因」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: the fact of being real or present

sentences.en: Few people knew of the island's ______.
sentences.zh: 很少人知道這座島的「存在」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: a possible effect or result of something

sentences.en: The ______s of the new law are still unclear.
sentences.zh: 新法律可能帶來的「影響」仍不清楚。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: the size or level of something

sentences.en: People were shocked by the ______ of the damage.
sentences.zh: 人們對損害的「規模」感到震驚。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to be more than a certain amount

sentences.en: Do not ______ the speed limit.
sentences.zh: 不要「超過」速限。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to become or make smaller or less

sentences.en: The pain will ______ after a few days.
sentences.zh: 疼痛幾天後會「減輕」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to include or surround

sentences.en: The national park ______es mountains, lakes, and forests.
sentences.zh: 這座國家公園「涵蓋」山脈、湖泊和森林。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to hide something

sentences.en: He tried to ______ his smile.
sentences.zh: 他試圖「掩飾」他的笑容。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: very weak or slight

sentences.en: The link between the two events is ______ at best.
sentences.zh: 這兩件事之間的關聯頂多算是「薄弱的」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: lasting for a long time

sentences.en: Their ______ friendship began in first grade.
sentences.zh: 他們「持久的」友誼從一年級就開始了。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: causing a lot of disagreement

sentences.en: School uniforms are a ______ topic among students.
sentences.zh: 校服在學生之間是個「有爭議的」話題。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: very easy to notice

sentences.en: She wore a ______ red hat so her friends could find her.
sentences.zh: 她戴了一頂「顯眼的」紅帽子，好讓朋友找到她。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: not aware of or not affected by

sentences.en: He seemed ______ the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 他似乎「感覺不到」寒風。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: clearly shown in

sentences.en: Her kindness is ______ the way she treats animals.
sentences.zh: 她的善良「表現在」她對待動物的方式上。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: examined very carefully by

sentences.en: Every page of the report was ______ the editors.
sentences.zh: 報告的每一頁都「受到」編輯的「仔細審查」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: made more difficult by

sentences.en: The rescue was ______ heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 救援行動「因」大雪「而變得複雜」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to make a bad situation worse

sentences.en: Scratching will only ______ the itch.
sentences.zh: 抓癢只會「加劇」搔癢。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to correct something that is wrong or unfair

sentences.en: The school added new courses to ______ the lack of art classes.
sentences.zh: 學校增設新課程，以「彌補」美術課的不足。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to be a perfect example of something

sentences.en: This small café ______s the town's friendly spirit.
sentences.zh: 這間小咖啡館「體現」了小鎮友善的精神。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to prevent something from happening

sentences.en: Bad weather may ______ an outdoor ceremony.
sentences.zh: 惡劣天氣可能使戶外典禮「無法舉行」。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to disagree in words about something

sentences.en: My brothers often ______ who gets the front seat.
sentences.zh: 我的兄弟們常「爭論」誰坐前座。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to think something is bad or wrong

sentences.en: My parents ______ playing video games late at night.
sentences.zh: 我父母「不贊成」深夜打電動。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to claim that something belongs to you

sentences.en: Both countries ______ the small island.
sentences.zh: 兩國都「宣稱擁有」這座小島。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: to act against or block something

sentences.en: Thick walls ______ strong winds.
sentences.zh: 厚牆能「抵擋」強風。

words.section: PART 1: Options from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–4 & Module 2 Q1–4)

words.defn_en: a wrong idea or belief

sentences.en: It is a common ______ that bats are blind.
sentences.zh: 蝙蝠是瞎子是一個常見的「誤解」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: worth noticing; important

sentences.en: The museum has a ______ collection of ancient coins.
sentences.zh: 這間博物館有一批「值得注意的」古錢幣收藏。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: closely packed together

sentences.en: The forest is so ______ planted that little light reaches the ground.
sentences.zh: 森林種得太「密」，很少光線能照到地面。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: plants in general, especially in an area

sentences.en: Thick ______ covers the riverbanks.
sentences.zh: 濃密的「植被」覆蓋著河岸。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: great excitement and interest

sentences.en: The kids showed great ______ for the science fair.
sentences.zh: 孩子們對科學展展現了極大的「熱忱」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: practices that keep people clean and healthy

sentences.en: Good ______ helps prevent illness.
sentences.zh: 良好的「衛生」習慣有助於預防疾病。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a useful feature or service that makes life comfortable

sentences.en: The hotel's ______s include a pool and a gym.
sentences.zh: 這家飯店的「設施」包括游泳池和健身房。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: naturally, without planning

sentences.en: The audience ______ began to sing along.
sentences.zh: 觀眾「自發地」開始跟著唱。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: great skill in music or another art

sentences.en: The violinist's ______ amazed the crowd.
sentences.zh: 那位小提琴家「精湛的技藝」讓觀眾驚嘆。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: the act of digging to find buried objects

sentences.en: The ______ uncovered ancient coins and pots.
sentences.zh: 這次「挖掘」出土了古代錢幣和陶罐。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to completely change or overturn

sentences.en: The discovery could ______ what we know about dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 這項發現可能「顛覆」我們對恐龍的認識。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: happening too early

sentences.en: It is ______ to celebrate before the game is over.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束前就慶祝還「太早」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: simple and roughly made

sentences.en: The children built a ______ raft from sticks.
sentences.zh: 孩子們用樹枝做了一個「簡陋的」木筏。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: in the surrounding area

sentences.en: The café plays soft ______ music.
sentences.zh: 咖啡館播放輕柔的「背景」音樂。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to suggest something as a fact or basis for argument

sentences.en: Scientists ______ that the planet once had oceans.
sentences.zh: 科學家「假定」這顆行星曾經有海洋。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: the relationship between a cause and its effect

sentences.en: The study shows a link but not ______.
sentences.zh: 這項研究顯示有關聯，但並非「因果關係」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to settle in and take control of a new area

sentences.en: Plants quickly ______ new volcanic islands.
sentences.zh: 植物很快就在新的火山島上「落地生根」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a line of descent from ancestors

sentences.en: The family can trace its ______ back 500 years.
sentences.zh: 這個家族的「血統」可以追溯到 500 年前。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to pull quickly with the fingers

sentences.en: He ______ed the guitar strings gently.
sentences.zh: 他輕輕「撥動」吉他弦。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: poisonous

sentences.en: Some mushrooms are ______ to humans.
sentences.zh: 有些蘑菇對人類「有毒」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to light up

sentences.en: Lanterns ______ the path at night.
sentences.zh: 燈籠在夜裡「照亮」小路。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to cover something so that it cannot get air

sentences.en: He ______ed the small fire with a wet blanket.
sentences.zh: 他用濕毯子「悶熄」小火。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: not following the usual way

sentences.en: She took an ______ path to becoming a doctor.
sentences.zh: 她走了一條「不尋常的」路成為醫生。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: broken into small pieces

sentences.en: The ______ ice floated down the river.
sentences.zh: 「碎裂的」冰塊順著河流漂下。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a nickname

sentences.en: Chicago has the ______ "the Windy City."
sentences.zh: 芝加哥有「風城」的「稱號」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a person who starts a business

sentences.en: The young ______ opened three cafés in two years.
sentences.zh: 這位年輕的「創業家」兩年內開了三家咖啡館。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: in a very detailed and complicated way

sentences.en: The box was ______ carved with flowers.
sentences.zh: 這個盒子上「精細地」雕刻著花朵。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to mix two different breeds or varieties

sentences.en: Farmers ______ cows to get more milk.
sentences.zh: 農民讓牛「雜交」以獲得更多牛奶。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: a mix of two different kinds

sentences.en: A mule is a ______ of a horse and a donkey.
sentences.zh: 騾是馬和驢的「混種」。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: melted by heat

sentences.en: ______ rock flows from the volcano.
sentences.zh: 「熔化的」岩石從火山流出。

words.section: PART 2: Key Words from Module 1 Passages

words.defn_en: to make something seem less important

sentences.en: Her brother's success ______ed her own achievements.
sentences.zh: 她哥哥的成功「掩蓋」了她自己的成就。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: happening at the same time

sentences.en: The two ______ festivals drew huge crowds.
sentences.zh: 兩個「同時舉行的」節慶吸引了大批人潮。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the existing state of things

sentences.en: Some people resist change and prefer the ______.
sentences.zh: 有些人抗拒改變，偏好「現狀」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the act of rejecting something

sentences.en: The speech was a clear ______ of violence.
sentences.zh: 這場演講明確「否定」了暴力。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: decoration

sentences.en: The church is famous for its golden ______.
sentences.zh: 這座教堂以金色的「裝飾」聞名。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: very carefully, with attention to detail

sentences.en: She ______ checked every answer.
sentences.zh: 她「一絲不苟地」檢查每一個答案。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to be a typical example of

sentences.en: These paintings ______ the artist's early style.
sentences.zh: 這些畫作是這位藝術家早期風格的「典型範例」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a group of people with something in common

sentences.en: This year's ______ of students is the largest ever.
sentences.zh: 今年這「一批」學生是歷來人數最多的。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a very large number of people or things

sentences.en: A ______ of stars filled the sky.
sentences.zh: 「無數」星星布滿天空。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: happy and suitable for a celebration

sentences.en: The streets had a ______ mood during the parade.
sentences.zh: 遊行期間街道充滿「歡樂的」氣氛。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: bringing strong images or memories to mind
words.defn_zh: 令人聯想的；喚起回憶的

sentences.en: The smell of rain is ______ of my childhood.
sentences.zh: 雨的氣味「讓我想起」童年。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: giving people more control over their lives

sentences.en: Education is a key to women's ______.
sentences.zh: 教育是女性「賦權」的關鍵。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the highest point

sentences.en: The empire reached its ______ in the 1500s.
sentences.zh: 這個帝國在 1500 年代達到「巔峰」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: aggressive and forceful in support of a cause

sentences.en: The group's ______ tactics scared some supporters.
sentences.zh: 這個團體「激進的」手段嚇跑了一些支持者。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to support an idea or belief

sentences.en: She ______s the idea that every child should learn to swim.
sentences.zh: 她「支持」每個孩子都該學游泳的想法。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the ability to continue without harming the environment

sentences.en: The town focuses on ______ by recycling and using solar power.
sentences.zh: 這個小鎮透過回收和使用太陽能來重視「永續性」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the variety of living things in an area

sentences.en: Rainforests have high ______.
sentences.zh: 熱帶雨林有很高的「生物多樣性」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: doubt about whether something is true

sentences.en: The claim was met with ______.
sentences.zh: 這個說法遭到「質疑」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: opposite to what one would expect

sentences.en: It seems ______, but drinking warm tea can cool you down.
sentences.zh: 這似乎「違反直覺」，但喝熱茶能讓你涼快。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to make something unstable

sentences.en: Heavy rain can ______ the hillside.
sentences.zh: 大雨可能使山坡「不穩定」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: strongly disliking or opposed to

sentences.en: My cat is ______ to baths.
sentences.zh: 我的貓「討厭」洗澡。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a sign that shows life exists or existed

sentences.en: Scientists search for ______s on other planets.
sentences.zh: 科學家在其他行星上尋找「生命跡象」。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to spread through something

sentences.en: The smell of bread ______d the whole house.
sentences.zh: 麵包的香味「瀰漫」整間屋子。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to slow down or block

sentences.en: Fallen trees ______d the rescue team.
sentences.zh: 倒下的樹木「阻礙」了救援隊。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: repeated without purpose (of animal behavior); fixed and typical

sentences.en: Bored zoo animals may show ______ pacing.
sentences.zh: 無聊的動物園動物可能出現「刻板的」踱步行為。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: without meaning to; by accident

sentences.en: He ______ deleted the file.
sentences.zh: 他「不小心」刪除了檔案。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: widely known and admired as a symbol

sentences.en: The Eiffel Tower is an ______ landmark.
sentences.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔是「具代表性的」地標。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: the bending of waves around edges

sentences.en: ______ makes light spread out after passing through a narrow gap.
sentences.zh: 「繞射」使光穿過狹縫後散開。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: better than all others; most important

sentences.en: She is the ______ expert on ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 她是古埃及研究「首屈一指的」專家。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to say that something was created or caused by someone
words.defn_zh: 歸因於；認為……是某人所作

sentences.en: The poem is ______d to an unknown monk.
sentences.zh: 這首詩「被認為是」一位不知名僧侶所作。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: to make something seem bigger or more important than it is

sentences.en: He ______d the size of the fish he caught.
sentences.zh: 他「誇大」了他釣到的魚的大小。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: understanding of an event after it has happened

sentences.en: In ______, I should have studied earlier.
sentences.zh: 「事後看來」，我應該早點念書。

words.section: PART 3: Key Words from Module 2 Passages

words.defn_en: a typical model or way of thinking

sentences.en: The invention of the internet created a new ______ for communication.
